# Vocal

> Vocal is a creator-first platform for discovering, supporting, and rewarding original fiction, poetry, and creative writing through community engagement and writing challenges.

Vocal connects readers with independent writers across multiple genres including fiction, poetry, and literary works. The platform features curated content discovery, community-driven challenges with cash prizes, and author profiles that showcase diverse creative talent.

## Key Topics

- creative writing
- fiction stories
- poetry
- author profiles
- writing challenges
- literary fiction
- content discovery
- creator communities
- user-generated content
- curated content
- multi-genre writing
- story collection
- poetry collection
- vocal platform
- content categories

## Core Platform

- [Vocal Homepage](https://vocal.media): Platform for supporting, discovering and rewarding creators
- [Explore](https://vocal.media/explore): Content discovery and community browsing across all categories
- [Communities](https://vocal.media/communities): Community directory for discovering interest-based creator communities

## Content Discovery & Curation

- [Top Stories](https://vocal.media/top-stories): Curated top stories across fiction, poetry and creative writing
- [Latest Stories](https://vocal.media/latest-stories): Latest user-submitted stories across multiple genres and categories
- [Fiction](https://vocal.media/fiction): Fiction community hub featuring handpicked short stories and literary works
- [Poets](https://vocal.media/poets): Poetry community hub featuring curated poems and poet showcase

## Writing Challenges & Contests

- [Challenges](https://vocal.media/challenges): Writing contests and creative challenges with cash prizes and themes

## Creator Resources

- [Resources](https://vocal.media/resources): Creator resources, tips, challenge winners and platform announcements

## Featured Authors

- [Aaron Morrison](https://vocal.media/authors/aaron-morrison-in5fa60d43): Author profile for Aaron Morrison showcasing his fiction and poetry works
- [Katherine D. Graham](https://vocal.media/authors/katherine-d-graham): Author profile for Katherine D. Graham, fiction and poetry writer
- [Carol Ann Townend](https://vocal.media/authors/carol-ann-townend): Author profile for Carol Ann Townend, multi-genre writer and published author
- [Raistlin Allen](https://vocal.media/authors/raistlin-allen): Author profile for Raistlin Allen showcasing creative writing and challenges

## Featured Stories & Poems

- [Rannor](https://vocal.media/fiction/rannor): Fantasy fiction story by Aaron Morrison featuring character Rannor
- [Working Together](https://vocal.media/fiction/working-together-z517500l6v): Dystopian fiction exploring climate anxiety and millennial relationships
- [Live For Today](https://vocal.media/poets/live-for-today-zjdcbm0zmg): Inspirational poem by Carol Ann Townend on resilience and personal growth
- [A Destination Needs A Dreamer](https://vocal.media/fiction/a-destination-needs-a-dreamer): Literary fiction by Raistlin Allen exploring ambition and character dreams
- [Something Borrowed](https://vocal.media/fiction/something-borrowed-262c8e03pc): Humorous wedding toast fiction by Cristal S. exploring family relationships
